generation.scope: For a reduced tetrahedral rank-one section at a simple or curvilinear finite mark, all six off-diagonal products in the two opposite coordinate systems coincide after a single unit normalization. Without opposite symmetry, their six alternating differences have disjoint supports of length one or two on the corresponding pairs of lines. The four diagonal corrections are quadratic and at least three are nonzero.

open_mathematics: Test the diagonal corrections against the adjacent complete intersection and extend the tetrahedral identities to nonreduced rank-one sections; continue the planar marks, higher ranks and branching cases.
